gloss: to turn awkward; to become stiff or stilted

definitions.gloss: to turn awkward; to become stiff (in movement or speech)
definitions.explanation: The adverbial form of the i-adjective ぎこちない (awkward, clumsy) plus なる. Describes a shift from natural to unnatural — often in conversation, body language, or movement when someone gets self-conscious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぎこちなくなった。
⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}けられる→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぎこちなくなる。
examples.english: My smile gets stiff whenever a camera is pointed at me.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ぎこちなくなった。
examples.english: After that topic came up, the two of them grew a little awkward with each other.

notes:
Formed from the i-adjective ⟦ぎこちない→ぎこちない：07366_gikochinai⟧ (awkward, clumsy, stilted) by replacing 〜い with 〜くなる (the standard 'become Adj' pattern). Used both physically and socially.

TYPICAL SUBJECTS:
- Speech and tone: ⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧、{言葉遣|ことばづか}い、⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧
- Body language: ⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧、⟦{動|うご}き→動く：00904_ugoku⟧、⟦{歩|ある}き{方|かた}→歩き方：28428_arukikata⟧
- Relationships: ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧、⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}まずく→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become awkward (socially) — emphasizes mutual discomfort, not stiffness of movement
- ⟦{不自然|ふしぜん}→不自然：11350_fushizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become unnatural — broader and more neutral
- ⟦{硬|かた}く→硬い：01116_katai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to stiffen up — used of nervous body language, often interchangeable
